apps/scaffolding-e2e/workflows/account-f: Blocked on a calimero-client-py release, not on anything in this repo. The scenario captures `revokedIn` from an account_revoke response and asserts the revocation reached both namespaces. `revoked_in` landed on core with #3435 on 2026-08-15; the released wheel was built before that, and because the binding deserializes into core's struct as compiled into the wheel, the field is absent from the response — CI shows `Export failed: 'revokedIn' not found. Available: accountId, deviceId, keyRotated`, so the placeholder stays literal and both assertions compare '{{revoked_in}}' to a namespace id. Register once a wheel built against current master is released AND merobox's pin (currently <0.6.26) moves onto it. The scenario and merobox's step are both correct; `outputs:` reads arbitrary response fields. Landed unregistered with #3435 and had never run.
apps/scaffolding-e2e/workflows/member-re: Docker-bridge partition primitives cannot construct the divergence deterministically: signing after the heal races the TCP-buffer drain, and signing during the partition is blocked by the readiness gate that requires mesh peers. The reconcile path is covered by unit tests on apply_group_op_mutations; registering this needs a more surgical partition primitive (e.g. an iptables-level drop on one peer pair). See the comment beside the matrix entry in e2e-rust-apps.yml.
